verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly offer a rules or automation engine, so this axis applies. The evidence documents only webhooks that notify you of event outcomes ([adyen-pos-docs-14], [adyen-pos-docs-21]). Webhooks are a developer building block for constructing your own automation, not a product-native way to define rules that trigger actions. No rule-definition or event-triggered action capability appears anywhere in the pack.
